name: Caps
notes: The most caps vendors will pay you a day, shared across every caps vendor. From the game files (vendor wallet Vendor_CapsBalance_Shared_Faction, default 1,400).

name: Legendary Scrip
notes: The most scrip the Legendary Exchange machines will give you a day, shared across every machine. From the game files (vendor wallet Vendor_CapsBalance_LegendaryVending, default 500).

name: Gold Bullion
notes: The most bullion the Gold Press machines will turn Treasury Notes into a day (40 notes). From the game files (vendor wallet Vendor_GoldBalance_Gold_VendingMachine, default 400). Separate weekly limit: 300 bullion bought at The Wayward (W05_BullionPurchasedMax, resets every week).

name: Treasury Notes
notes: 40 notes a day can be turned in at the Gold Press machines (400 bullion, 10 bullion per note).
